Question: What is the average grade in the programming intro class taught by Dr. Chen in the winter term of 2025?

output.plan: Find offerings in 2025 winter-term semesters taught by a teacher whose name contains 'Chen', for a course whose title mentions both 'intro' and 'program'. Then average the non-NULL grades per offering. Ungraded (NULL) enrollments are excluded. The course and teacher are matched by name patterns, so the result lists course code, title and teacher so you can check the match.
output.sql: SELECT co.id AS offering_id, c.code, c.title, t.id AS teacher_id, t.name AS teacher_name, s.name AS semester_name, AVG(e.grade) AS avg_grade, COUNT(e.grade) AS graded_enrollments FROM course_offerings co JOIN courses c ON c.id = co.course_id JOIN teachers t ON t.id = co.teacher_id JOIN semesters s ON s.id = co.semester_id LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.offering_id = co.id WHERE s.year = 2025 AND LOWER(s.term) LIKE '%winter%' AND t.name LIKE '%Chen%' AND LOWER(c.title) LIKE '%intro%' AND LOWER(c.title) LIKE '%program%' GROUP BY co.id, c.code, c.title, t.id, t.name, s.name
